shape: Diagonal two-portal arena (N + S on opposite quadrants)
description: Two-portal arena where the gates sit on diagonally-opposite quadrants: spawn_north at NW (low-X, low-Z), spawn_south at SE (high-X, high-Z). The south entry hub (omamui) is the highest-degree node, reaching the center and 3 corners + the south-center. The center (sv520a) connects east, SE pocket, NW (g7kjd9), and SW pocket (gcnzgi). The north entry hub (sfbrne) is sparser, joining only the NW corridor (g7kjd9).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-16.89, -22.91) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, west column
portals.south: spawn_south at (17.02, 22.43) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column

anchors.description: south entry hub — high-degree pivot to corners + south-center (matches omamui)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → nw_corner → center → south_inner → spawn_south (or via south_center). Five hops.
DISPATCH RULE: south_inner is the super-hub for south-side and center objectives. north_inner is sparse — only NW corridor is direct; cross-room objectives all go through south_inner / center.
Multiple detour pockets (sw_corner, se_pocket, east_arm) for corner-objective dispatch.
Same pattern family as the diagonal-portal arenas (ic1 wetlands) but more wide-open and less corridor-y.
